analysis.title: The Point for North America, Monday, 23 November 2026
key_insights: Citi's PULSE Monitor says the AI bottleneck trades are unraveling. Semis were 20% of S&P 500 weight heading into Q4 and have sold off 25%+ since Oct 6, implying a 4%+ index headwind.

Defensive positions that had benefited from semi selling have also begun to unravel. Citi cites liquidity gaps, deleveraging, year-end gain locking and offsides positioning, and notes earnings expectations are unchanged while the Levkovich Index has come off but remains in euphoria.

Citi's crowding report shows tech crowding at year-to-date lows after post-midterm volatility. Drawdowns concentrated in the most crowded quintile, Energy remains the most crowded sector in the US and Europe, TSLA is the sole significant crowded Mag7 long and AAPL moved into crowded short territory.

Commodities saw a broad sell-off. Gold is down $2,000/oz (-35%) in 9 months, copper is down nearly $3,000/t (-20%), and diesel, gasoline and TTF are 20-35% off YTD highs. Citi sees ags and diesel/gasoil as the exceptions worth buying, with near-dated diesel and US gas risks skewed up.

Citi US economics expects the Fed to hike 25bp in December 2026 but cut in 2027 on cooler inflation, growth concerns and tighter financial conditions. 2-year yields fell with equities as markets price a slowdown in AI investment.

Swaps Scoreboard 3Q26: CFG and KEY top the stack rank in a flat-rate scenario. On the 9/30 curve pricing about 100bps of hikes, BAC screens as the beneficiary with NIM drag flat at about 8bps and about $60B of 2027 maturities.

Intuit F1Q27 was mixed. The FY27 Credit Karma growth guide was cut to 3-7% from 11-13% on AI-related top-of-funnel and macro/rate impacts. Citi stays Buy and cuts the TP to $343 from $416, saying challenges are priced in at 10.6x FY28 PE.
Salesforce F3Q27 preview: fieldwork suggests sluggish core growth and limited production AI deployments. Citi stays Neutral and cuts TP to $198 from $263, and sees a 60-70bp FX headwind to H2.
BILL is being acquired by TPG and Corpay for $63.25 per share in cash. Citi downgrades to Neutral with TP $63.25, and says it expected a price near $75+.
Elastic had a strong Q2 with Cloud and sales-led subscription accelerating and about 20% cRPO growth. Guidance was noisier on FX and EMEA conservatism, and Citi keeps Buy/High Risk.
Citi initiates Recursion at Buy/High Risk with a $7 TP. The thesis rests on more than $535M of partnership proceeds and REC-4881 in FAP (Citi peak est $2.5B) moving to phase 3 in 2H27.
Nextpower CMD introduced FY30 targets. Lower FY28 margins drove a sharp pullback, but revenue outlook beat Citi's $7.1B estimate. Citi stays Buy with PT cut to $124 from $126.
AI inference note: GPT-6.2 Astra and Gemini 4 Neon gained 5 and 10 AA intelligence points at 36% and 25% lower cost per task. The cheapest model matching the 9/2 frontier is 96% cheaper per task.

Citi's Cloud Forum on Nov 30 at AWS re:Invent is expected to favor infrastructure/data names MSFT, MDB, SNOW, ESTC, PLTR from AI diffusion, while CRM, ADBE, HUBS, NICE face pressure from AI-natives like Sierra. Citi's chart shows AWS revenue reaching $1T in 10 years at a 19% CAGR.

RE+ takeaways: industry and SEIA favor a roughly 2-year ITC extension. Residential solar remains weak, utility-scale is constructive, storage is a bright spot, and 2028 module pricing could exceed $0.40/W.
Ovintiv: 2027 plan not final, leaning toward low-single-digit organic growth with robust buybacks. Cash return floor is 50% of FCF.

earnings_insights: Intuit F1Q27 (reported): mixed, profitability upside and solid GBS, but FY27 Credit Karma growth guide cut to 3-7% y/y from 11-13%. Citi FY27E EPS diluted $16.69 vs consensus $16.76.
Intuit Citi F4Q27E (estimate): total revenue $12,298M vs consensus $12,343M, EPS diluted $3.49 vs consensus $3.56.
Salesforce F3Q27 (preview, not yet reported): Citi expects a slight mechanical reacceleration in organic subscription growth and slight cc beat. FX seen as a 60-70bp H2 headwind.
Elastic Q2 (reported): Cloud and sales-led subscription accelerated on about 20% cRPO growth. Q3 guide slightly below, implied Q4 above, FY29 target of 20%+.
BILL (Citi estimates vs consensus): FY27E non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.50 vs consensus $4.66 per Citi table. Deal at $63.25 per share cash.
Agios 3Q26 (reported): steady Aqvesme thalassemia launch with about 75% of patients on therapy beyond 6 months. SCD PDUFA is February 1, 2027.
Nextpower CMD: revenue outlook above Citi's above-consensus $7.1B estimate, but FY28 margin outlook was a negative surprise.
BJ's, TGT and WMT estimates updated after 3Q26 earnings.
Marathon Petroleum model update: TP falls to $415 on lower forward margins.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Citi sees Fed officials determined to hike, followed by cuts in 2027.
Market pricing is starting to show modest cuts later in 2027 on cooler inflation and growth concerns.
The curve used in the bank swaps scenario embeds hikes, benefiting BAC's NIM drag.
Higher real rates and risk asset weakness drive the sell-off.
Mining marginal cost support is still about 20% lower.
